instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL UI text is entirely in natural German (German language App).
Ensure dark mode is the default and only primary aesthetic with rich obsidian backgrounds (#0B0F17) and subtle border styling.
Always apply data-testid on all interactive components (buttons, inputs, menu items, toggles, cards).
Use lucide-react icons exclusively for crisp iconography.
Implement WebAuthn fingerprint login as a functional demo flow that validates user authentication seamlessly.
Integrate profile color everywhere user data appears (Calendar appointment badges, Whiteboard pen color, Avatar rings).
Ensure the application behaves as a fully installable PWA with service worker registration and dark theme manifest settings.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT center align the entire app container or rely on plain generic layouts.
Avoid universal CSS transitions like transition: all which disrupt transform animations.
Every key interaction must feature tactile feedback: micro-animations, hover states, and smooth glassmorphism popovers.
Provide clear data-testid attributes using kebab-case across all buttons, inputs, modals, and lists.
Use sonner for user feedback toasts in German (e.g., 'Gericht hinzugefügt', 'Einkaufsliste aktualisiert', 'Daten exportiert').
